commit.message:
feat(deployment, examples, src/photonic_neuromorphics): add comprehensive photonic neuromorphics research demo and infrastructure (#9)

- Add production Docker Compose setup for photonic neuromorphics API and services
- Add Kubernetes manifests for namespace, deployments, services, ingress, autoscaling, and network policies
- Add Terraform configuration for multi-cloud infrastructure provisioning (AWS, GCP, Azure) with VPC, EKS, RDS, ElastiCache, ALB, CloudFront, WAF
- Introduce advanced photonic neuromorphics research demo script showcasing architecture comparisons, wavelength optimization, plasticity algorithms, scaling, noise resilience, and publication-ready results
- Implement new photonic neuromorphics modules:
  - architectures: photonic crossbar, reservoir, convolutional networks
  - benchmarks: comprehensive benchmarking suite with dataset loaders and comparative analysis
  - components: advanced photonic components including Mach-Zehnder neurons, microring resonators, phase-change materials
  - hpc: high-performance computing framework with distributed computing, GPU acceleration, cluster management, and performance optimization
- Update __init__.py to expose new modules and functions

This commit establishes a full-stack research and deployment framework for photonic neuromorphic computing, enabling advanced simulation, benchmarking, and scalable cloud deployment.

Co-authored-by: terragon-labs[bot] <terragon-labs[bot]@users.noreply.github.com>
